title: EU court rules commission failed to act on citizens’ initiative calling for ban on animal cages
lede: In the first ruling of its kind, the European Court of Justice decided that insufficient action was taken by the EU Commission after 1.4 million people signed an European Citizens’ Initiative petition to ban cages for farmed animals. The Brussels executive is expected to propose a cage phase-out plan in December.

title: Comment: How investors can turn conflict-zone due diligence into decisions
lede: New UN investor guidance aims to translate heightened human rights due diligence into decisions, writes Gerald Pachoud.

title: EU commission proposes €50bn tech fund to buy into AI, quantum and other strategic companies
lede: The EU Commission has presented plans to launch a €50bn tech sovereignty fund to take stakes in strategic companies to prevent them leaving to the US or China.

title: Canadian investors increasingly cite fiduciary duty as ESG driver
lede: Investor survey finds two-thirds consider fiduciary duty a reason to adopt ESG, but performance concerns remain.
